Test Name: authenticate as the shared dashboard user
What it Verifies: Signs in once per run and caches the session to playwright/.auth/user.json
Key Assertion: Log Out button is visible and the URL is /ai_dashboard
Notes: Every browser project depends on this; it is the suite's entry-criteria check

What it Verifies: Registers a new account with a unique e-mail and a valid password
Key Assertion: 'Your account has been created' is visible and the app returns to the login page
Notes: Creates a real pending-approval account on the dev environment

What it Verifies: Confirm Password must match Password
Key Assertion: 'Confirm password does not match the password.' is visible

What it Verifies: Rejects a password shorter than 8 characters
Key Assertion: The password policy message is visible

What it Verifies: Rejects a password with no uppercase letter
Key Assertion: The password policy message is visible

What it Verifies: Rejects a password with no digit
Key Assertion: The password policy message is visible

What it Verifies: Rejects a password with no special character
Key Assertion: The password policy message is visible

What it Verifies: Asserts that '!' is accepted as a special character
Key Assertion: The password policy message is hidden
Notes: Fails today - the assertion encodes the correct behaviour

What it Verifies: Rejects a malformed e-mail address
Key Assertion: The account-created message stays hidden

What it Verifies: Confirm stays disabled until all three fields are filled
Key Assertion: Button enablement is re-checked after each field

What it Verifies: Signs in with the shared credentials
Key Assertion: Log Out is visible, URL is /ai_dashboard, the search box is rendered

What it Verifies: Rejects a valid user with the wrong password
Key Assertion: The credentials error is visible and Log Out stays hidden

What it Verifies: Rejects an unknown user
Key Assertion: The same generic error is shown - no user enumeration

What it Verifies: Sign in stays disabled while either field is empty
Key Assertion: Enablement is re-checked after filling and clearing each field

What it Verifies: Rejects a malformed e-mail address
Key Assertion: Log Out stays hidden

What it Verifies: Failed sign-in must answer 401, not 500
Key Assertion: The /api/ai_dashboard/login response status is 401

What it Verifies: Signs out and returns to the login screen
Key Assertion: URL matches /ai_dashboard/login and the e-mail field is visible

What it Verifies: Logout must clear the token and patient PII
Key Assertion: localStorage session, user and persist:root are all null
Notes: Fails today - all three survive logout

What it Verifies: Session survives a page reload
Key Assertion: Log Out is still visible and the login form is hidden

What it Verifies: An unauthenticated visitor is sent to the login screen
Key Assertion: The e-mail field and Sign in button are visible

What it Verifies: Sidebar shows the user and the Diagnosis List destination
Key Assertion: The nav entry and Log Out are visible

What it Verifies: All toolbar controls render
Key Assertion: Download, date, Channel, search, Search and the counter are visible

What it Verifies: Each status tab loads and keeps the table rendered
Key Assertion: Table and counter stay visible on each tab
Notes: Data-driven over the three tabs; structural only while the list is empty

What it Verifies: Completed adds a 'Completed by' column
Key Assertion: Header arrays are compared exactly for Open and Completed

What it Verifies: Each triage chip is present
Key Assertion: Data-driven over the five chips

What it Verifies: Channel dropdown opens and lists every channel
Key Assertion: All four channel labels are visible

What it Verifies: Date-range picker offers the documented presets
Key Assertion: Six representative presets are visible

What it Verifies: The selected tab should survive a reload
Key Assertion: The Completed-only column is still present after a reload
Notes: Fails today - tab state is not in the URL

What it Verifies: Generates a record in the consumer app, then searches for it in the dashboard
Key Assertion: Total cases > 0 and the Diagnosis column contains the generated diagnosis
Notes: Marked test.slow(); the questionnaire takes minutes

What it Verifies: An unknown term returns an empty result
Key Assertion: Total cases is 0 and the empty state is visible
Notes: Passes vacuously while the list is always empty

What it Verifies: Clearing the search restores the baseline count
Key Assertion: The count returns to its starting value

What it Verifies: A SQL-injection style term is handled safely
Key Assertion: The table stays rendered and no database error text appears

What it Verifies: Injected script is not executed
Key Assertion: No dialog event fires during the search

What it Verifies: A whitespace-only term behaves as an empty search
Key Assertion: The count matches the baseline

What it Verifies: The typed term stays in the box after searching
Key Assertion: The input still holds the term

What it Verifies: Filters by each triage in turn
Key Assertion: Rows are returned, or the documented empty state is shown

What it Verifies: Filters by each channel in turn
Key Assertion: Every visible Channel cell matches the selected channel
Notes: Data-driven over four channels; asserts row contents, not just counts

What it Verifies: Filters to today only
Key Assertion: Every Date-time value falls on today's date

What it Verifies: A narrower date range never returns more records
Key Assertion: Today's count is <= the 90-day count

What it Verifies: Combines a triage, a channel and a date range
Key Assertion: The table and counter stay rendered through all three selections

What it Verifies: Combines a filter with a search term
Key Assertion: The searched count is <= the filtered count

What it Verifies: Reselecting All restores the baseline
Key Assertion: The count returns to its starting value

What it Verifies: Download opens a confirmation modal
Key Assertion: Confirm and cancel actions are both visible

What it Verifies: Cancelling downloads nothing
Key Assertion: No download event fires and the modal closes

What it Verifies: Confirming downloads a non-empty CSV
Key Assertion: A .csv download arrives and its first line contains a delimiter
Notes: Fails today - no file is produced

What it Verifies: Exporting with no records must give feedback
Key Assertion: Either a download or an API request must occur

What it Verifies: The export respects the active tab and filters
Key Assertion: A .csv download arrives after filtering
